supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: visible lateral extension beyond the outer eye corners

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: high contrast between the light, mottled muzzle area and the dark periocular regions

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: mottled depigmentation patches visible on the muzzle skin
other_distinctive_markers: prominent localized cluster of white hair on the chin
